h1: Custom Unisex Lanyards for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom unisex lanyards in bulk for your team or event. Durable, comfortable, and fully customizable at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Unisex lanyards are designed to fit comfortably on any wearer, making them a practical choice for corporate events, trade shows, or daily ID badge use. Unlike gendered alternatives, these lanyards offer a neutral fit with adjustable lengths and a variety of attachment options like badge holders or key rings. Choose from polyester, nylon, or eco-friendly materials, and add your logo with screen printing or dye sublimation for a crisp, all-over design. Whether you need 50 or 5,000, custom unisex lanyards keep your brand visible and accessible.
heroAltText: Custom unisex lanyards with printed logos and badge holders displayed on a neutral background.
